verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents BVNK's REST API, Portal, webhooks and sandbox, plus an llms.txt file and an 'agent-wallet-cli' repository, but nothing shows the product accepting or executing natural-language commands. An llms.txt docs file helps LLMs read the documentation, and a CLI is a structured command interface, so both are at most adjacent building blocks and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
